suggested_fix: No fix required. The function flushes the serdev write buffer, purges the TX queue, waits for pending TX work with cancel_work_sync(), and frees rx_skb only after checking it with IS_ERR_OR_NULL(). That check matters because h4_recv_buf() can leave an ERR_PTR value in rx_skb. The pointer is then reset to NULL, so it cannot be freed twice or used after it is freed.
